description: Source code for command-line post management commands in Mattermost, including creating, listing, revealing, and deleting posts.

methods.name: postCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new post with specified message and optional reply-to and burn-on-read flag.

methods.name: eventDataToPost
methods.description: Converts event data map to a Post object.

methods.name: printPost
methods.description: Prints a post with optional timestamp and ID display, including burn-on-read expiration info.

methods.name: getPostList
methods.description: Retrieves list of posts for a channel, optionally since a specific time.

methods.name: postListCmdF
methods.description: Handles listing posts in a channel, with optional follow for real-time updates.

methods.name: deletePostsCmdF
methods.description: Deletes or permanently deletes posts based on flags, with confirmation.

methods.name: revealPostCmdF
methods.description: Reveals a specific post by ID.
